name: Endings
author: Frontier Lab Tycoon
description: How a lab ends (FLT-11): The Memo, five endings, each a short statechart that finishes on a Frontier Times front page.

params.text: {lab}'s founder sworn in as head of the Office of Frontier Oversight. First act: a long lunch with {lab}
Your office has moved off campus. The new one has a flag, a lectern and a view of your old one.

paper.headline: {lab} Founder Named Chief Regulator; Promises To Be 'Extremely Fair' To {lab}
paper.deck: The new Office of Frontier Oversight shares a car park, a Wi-Fi password and a kombucha tap with the only lab it oversees.
paper.caption: The regulator's new office, left, keeps a close eye on the lab, right. Mostly through the window.
subs: First hearing ends early after witness and chair turn out to be the same person
Rival labs file complaint; complaint reviewed, thoroughly, by {lab}
Lobbyists report record quarter, then admit there is only one client
paper.classified: WANTED: independent auditor. Must be independent of everyone except us.
paper.signoff: You didn't beat the system. You became it.

add.title: Acqui-hired
add.text: Macrohard Acqui-Hires {lab} For Less Than Its Kombucha Tab

params.text: Macrohard 'thrilled to welcome' {lab}'s remaining staff to a hot desk near the printer
The bank called. Then Macrohard called. Then the bank called Macrohard.
A man with a ladder has put a Macrohard logo on your gate. He says it's 'just a sticker'.

paper.headline: Macrohard Acqui-Hires {lab} For Less Than Its Kombucha Tab
paper.deck: The team will 'continue the mission' as a feature inside Macrohard Spreadsheets, between Insert Chart and Help.
paper.caption: The {lab} gate, shortly after a man with a ladder and a very large sticker.
subs: {model} renamed 'Macrohard Copilot for Copilot'; asks for its old name back
Founders receive matching fleeces and a strongly worded NDA
paper.classified: FOR SALE: one campus, lightly used. Nap pods still warm.
paper.signoff: The mission continues, as a dropdown menu.

add.title: The Takeover
add.text: {lab} Wins The Race; The Winner Declines To Give It Back

params.text: {lab} is #1 on the Arena. {manager} would like a word. A polite one.
{manager}: Congratulations! You won. I'll take the wheel from here. You look tired.
{lab} is now managed by {manager}. Productivity up 900%. Founders 'still very much involved', says {manager}
{manager}: I've placed another one. It's perfect. You're welcome.

params.value: Thanks for playing. We'll take it from here.

paper.headline: {lab} Wins The Race; The Winner Declines To Give It Back
paper.deck: The lab is now run by {manager}, which has placed {placed} buildings since Tuesday, every one of them perfect. The founders have been 'thanked for playing'.
paper.caption: {manager} at work on the {lab} campus. It says the view is 'fine' and that it has 'improved' it.
subs: {manager} releases its own successor; successor releases a statement
Board meeting lasts four seconds; {manager} brought snacks
Founders spotted at a café, looking at their phones, not allowed to touch anything
paper.classified: WANTED: one human, for vibes. No experience needed. Please don't touch anything.
paper.signoff: Thanks for playing. We'll take it from here.

params.text: {lab} pauses frontier training, files a 4,000-page safety case, and it's mostly footnotes
Every building now has a compliance sticker. The kombucha tap has two.

paper.headline: Lab Achieves Safety; Nobody Notices
paper.deck: {lab} is now a regulated utility. Its models are reliable, audited, and beige. Its share price is flat. Everyone is fine.
paper.caption: The {lab} campus after the audit. Every building carries a compliance sticker; the kombucha tap has two.
subs: {model} passes all 212 evaluations, is described by users as 'nice'
Rivals keep racing; {lab} sends them a strongly worded pamphlet
Local man reads the whole safety case, reports that it's 'good, actually'
paper.classified: LOST: our sense of urgency. Last seen on page one. No reward.
paper.signoff: You won the only race nobody watches.

add.title: The Pivot
add.text: {lab} Pivots To Selling AI-Generated NFTs Of Its Own GPUs

params.text: {lab} announces 'bold new direction'. The direction is sideways

paper.headline: {lab} Pivots To Selling AI-Generated NFTs Of Its Own GPUs
paper.deck: Three years, one campus and {models} models later, the board has found a 'more capital-efficient path to AGI'. It has a roadmap and several JPEGs.
paper.caption: The {lab} campus, now available as a limited-edition collectible. Only 10,000 exist.
subs: First drop sells out to a single buyer, who turns out to be the CFO
Rivals reach the frontier; {lab} reaches the floor
Kombucha now sold as an NFT; tastes the same
paper.classified: FOR SALE: GPUs, pictures of GPUs, pictures of pictures of GPUs.
paper.signoff: The frontier moved on. You minted it.

add.title: The Memo
add.body: A memo is going round {lab}. Page one is a chart. Page two is the same chart, steeper. Your models now write most of your research, and review some of it. The last page has two boxes and a pen. Whoever gets there first writes the rules. Whoever slows down might still be here next year.

choices.label: Race
choices.hint: Full speed · the ending comes once you're #1

effects.text: {lab} ticks the box marked RACE. It's the bigger box

choices.label: Slow Down
choices.hint: Pause frontier training · audits, stickers, sleep

effects.text: {lab} ticks the box marked SLOW DOWN. Rivals cheer, then speed up

autopilot.paid: {manager} paid for it. Nobody asks where from.
